svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="jvkszjUy6ykkl4Zpc8be"> <mxGraphModel dx="3258" dy="1842" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml UC06_View_Staff_Overview
!pragma teoz true

' =========================================================
' Visual configuration
' =========================================================
skinparam backgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam dpi 160
skinparam maxMessageSize 90
skinparam ParticipantPadding 24
skinparam BoxPadding 12

skinparam sequence {
 ArrowColor #334155
 ArrowFontColor #0F172A
 ArrowFontSize 12

 ActorBorderColor #2563EB
 ActorBackgroundColor #EFF6FF
 ActorFontColor #0F172A

 ParticipantBorderColor #2563EB
 ParticipantBackgroundColor #EFF6FF
 ParticipantFontColor #0F172A

 LifeLineBorderColor #94A3B8
 LifeLineBackgroundColor #DBEAFE

 GroupBorderColor #64748B
 GroupBackgroundColor #F8FAFC
 GroupHeaderFontColor #0F172A

 DividerBackgroundColor #DBEAFE
 DividerBorderColor #2563EB
 DividerFontColor #1E3A8A

 NoteBorderColor #F59E0B
 NoteBackgroundColor #FFFBEB
 NoteFontColor #78350F
}

hide footbox
autonumber 1 \"<b>[00]</b>\"

title <size:20><b>UC-06 View Staff Workload, Availability and Preferences</b></size>\n<size:12>Music School Workload Management System</size>

' =========================================================
' Participants
' =========================================================
actor \"Staff Member\" as Viewer

box \"Music School Workload Management System\" #F8FAFC
 boundary \"StaffOverviewPage\n<<boundary>>\" as UI
 control \"WorkloadController\n<<control>>\" as WC
 entity \"StaffMember\n<<entity>>\" as Staff
 entity \"TeachingJob\n<<entity>>\" as Job
 entity \"AvailabilityRecord\n<<entity>>\" as Availability
 entity \"JobPreference\n<<entity>>\" as Preference
end box

' =========================================================
' Open Staff overview
' =========================================================
Viewer -> UI : openStaffOverview()
activate UI

UI -> WC : requestCurrentWeekOverview(viewerId)
activate WC

' =========================================================
' Authorisation
' =========================================================
WC -> WC : authoriseStaffAccess(viewerId)

alt Access denied
 WC --> UI : accessDenied()
 UI --> Viewer : displayAccessDenied()

else Authorised Staff Member
 WC -> WC : determineCurrentWeek(SingaporeTime)

 ' -----------------------------------------------------
 ' Retrieve colleagues
 ' -----------------------------------------------------
 WC -> Staff : findOtherActiveStaff(viewerId)
 activate Staff

 Staff --> WC : colleagues
 deactivate Staff

 alt No other active Staff Members
 WC --> UI : emptyOverview(currentWeek)

 UI --> Viewer : displayNoColleaguesMessage()

 note over Viewer, UI
 The overview is displayed successfully,
 but no other active Staff Members exist.
 end note

 else Other Staff Members found

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Load permitted information for each colleague
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 loop For each other Staff Member
 WC -> Job : calculateAssignedHours(\ncolleagueId, currentWeek)
 activate Job

 Job --> WC : assignedHours
 deactivate Job

 WC -> Availability : findForWeek(\ncolleagueId, currentWeek)
 activate Availability

 Availability --> WC : availabilityRecord or notSubmitted
 deactivate Availability

 WC -> Preference : findForWeek(\ncolleagueId, currentWeek)
 activate Preference

 Preference --> WC : preferenceRecord or notSubmitted
 deactivate Preference

 WC -> WC : buildPermittedOverviewRow(\ncolleague, assignedHours,\navailability, preferences)
 end

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Apply privacy and empty-state rules
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 WC -> WC : applyPrivacyProjection(colleagueRows)

 note over WC #FFFBEB
 Include only:
 - Staff Member name
 - Assigned hours
 - Availability
 - Job preferences

 Exclude:
 - Contact details
 - Leave or MC records
 - Supporting documents
 - Student details
 end note

 WC -> WC : applyDisplayStates(colleagueRows)

 note over WC #E0F2FE
 Display rules:
 - No assigned jobs: 0 assigned hours
 - No availability record: Not submitted
 - Blank submitted preferences: No preferences indicated
 - No preference submission: Not submitted
 end note

 WC --> UI : permittedOverview(\ncurrentWeek, colleagueRows)

 UI --> Viewer : displayStaffOverview(\ncurrentWeek, colleagueRows)
 end
end

deactivate WC
deactivate UI

' =========================================================
' Postcondition
' =========================================================
note over Viewer, Preference #E0F2FE
 Read-only interaction.
 No system data is created, updated, or deleted.
 The latest saved information is retrieved whenever
 the Staff overview is loaded.
end note

' =========================================================
' Legend
' =========================================================
legend right
 |= Colour |= Meaning |
 |<#EFF6FF> Blue | System participants |
 |<#E0F2FE> Light blue | Display or read-only rule |
 |<#FFFBEB> Amber | Privacy constraint |
endlegend

@enduml",
